fieldguide.entity.spawn.coastal_crab.goi:
A neutral mob found on beaches that can shoot Bubbles and bury itself. Fits in a Bucket. 

This variant fiercely defends crabapple trees, depending on their fruit and saplings to breed.
fieldguide.entity.spawn.coastal_crab.spa:
A neutral mob found on beaches that can shoot Bubbles and bury itself. Fits in a Bucket. 

This variant occasionally displays hostile behavior towards Villagers.
fieldguide.going_coastal.crabapple_sapli: A flowering tree occasionally found on beaches. It sports crabgrass on its leaves, which rarely drop its namesake in the form of a tough and sour fruit.
